note_en: 一边A，一边B describes two actions done at the same time: 一边赏月，一边分享手中的月饼 "admiring the moon while sharing the mooncakes in their hands." English uses "while" or "as" once, but Chinese puts 一边 before each verb, and both actions share the same subject.
